summary: docs(mcp): correct the drift and rollup capability claims in the novel-feature index
reason: The generated novel-feature index in internal/mcp/tools.go (command_mirror_capabilities and playbook, both seeded from .printing-press.json) advertised two capabilities the hand-authored detector layer does not have, and an agent reading the index would call them and misread the result. (1) drift was described as scanning journal entries for debit≠credit imbalances: it does not, and cannot — the mirror's journal lines carry a signed `amount` with no debit/credit direction, so the imbalance is not computable from the GET data (see the header of internal/cli/drift.go). drift actually scans sales and purchases for total_mismatch, the per-vatType regime invariants, settled_residual and currency_mismatch, in exact øre. (2) rollup was described as grouping by month, account, project, or contact, and its rationale claimed a join to project: --by accepts only month|account|contact and rejects `project` with an explicit error, because the mirrored sales/purchase lines carry no project. Three literal string edits, each marked with a // PATCH(mcp-novel-feature-claims) comment: the drift description, the rollup description plus its rationale, and the rollup playbook insight. The same claims were corrected in the hand-authored .printing-press.json, SKILL.md and README.md, and scripts/check-boundaries.sh check (e) now greps all four files for the two claim shapes so a reprint or a copied blurb fails closed.
call_sites: journal debit/credit imbalance is not checked
rollups over the local mirror by month, account, or contact.
(joined to contact) with margin computed in exact øre
validated_outcome: make check passes: go vet ./..., go test ./..., and scripts/check-boundaries.sh (marker consistency, vatType prefix lint, patch-record ledger, and the new doc-claims grep). Claims re-derived by reading internal/cli/drift.go and internal/cli/rollup.go. No API call was made.
